personality: 8 Hand-Drawn / Journal LIGHT with 3 Editorial structure
personality_one_liner: A calm, grounded, premium AI-powered wellness companion for India that blends ancient wisdom with modern nutrition science in English and Telugu.

spacing.rule: Generous editorial rhythm, clean tactile padding, compact touch targets >= 44pt

do's: Use frosted glass header and tab bar over scrolling content
Apply translucent tinted base with >= 75% opacity for readability
dont's: Do not use glass on form inputs or dense data tables
Never stack more than 2 blur surfaces on one screen

screens.name: Auth & Language
screens.purpose: Secure authentication with Google/Email and English/Telugu language toggle.
screens.layout: Editorial full-bleed welcome with bilingual language picker at top right, secure auth form with clean input cards, and sticky action buttons.

screens.name: Onboarding Profile
screens.purpose: Multi-step profile setup capturing physical metrics, health conditions, dietary preferences, and cooking budget.

states.empty: Start entering your details to personalize NutriMitra.
states.error: Failed to save profile. Tap retry.

screens.layout: Step-by-step wizard with progress indicator, segmented selectors for diet and activity, and sticky bottom navigation.

screens.name: Personalized 7-Day Plan
screens.purpose: AI-generated tailored nutrition and activity plan for the week.

states.loading: Generating your custom 7-day Indian nutrition plan...
states.empty: Complete your onboarding to unlock your weekly plan.
states.error: Could not generate plan. Check connection.

screens.layout: Tabbed day selector (Day 1-7) with meal cards showing breakfast, lunch, dinner, snacks, and nutrition macro split.

screens.name: Daily Dashboard
screens.purpose: Central command center for daily meals, activity tracking, energy score, and What Should I Eat Now.

states.empty: Log your first meal or activity to see your daily score.

screens.layout: Sticky glass header, daily readiness meter hero card, What Should I Eat Now quick action banner, and checklist of daily tasks.

screens.name: What Should I Eat Now
screens.purpose: Instant AI meal recommendation based on time of day, remaining macros, pantry ingredients, and mood.

states.loading: Analyzing your pantry & current nutrition balance...
states.empty: Add ingredients or dietary goals to get instant meal suggestions.

screens.layout: Contextual recommendation card with preparation time, estimated calories, recipe ingredients, and one-tap log action.

screens.name: Meal & Snack Tracking
screens.purpose: Log meals via manual search, barcode, or photo recognition with AI confirmation and substitutions.

states.loading: Identifying food from photo and database...
states.empty: No meals logged for this mealtime yet. Tap + to add.
states.error: Photo recognition failed. Try manual search.

screens.layout: Split view with photo capture/upload zone, searchable Indian ingredient database, and confirmation modal with macro breakdown.

screens.name: Conversational AI Coach
screens.purpose: Interactive wellness and nutrition coaching companion supporting English and Telugu.

states.empty: Ask NutriMitra anything about Indian superfoods, recipes, or workout tips.
states.error: Message failed to send. Tap to retry.

screens.layout: Chat interface with suggested quick prompts, voice input option, and structured recipe/tip cards inside chat.

screens.name: Workouts & Activity
screens.purpose: Personalized home, gym, or outdoor workouts, walking/running guidance, and HealthKit/Health Connect sync.

states.loading: Syncing wearable metrics and workout plans...
states.empty: No workouts scheduled for today. Start a walking session.

screens.layout: Wearable sync status banner, step/distance tracker ring, daily workout routine card, and manual activity entry sheet.

screens.name: Weight & Wellness Progress
screens.purpose: Weekly reviews, weight trend graphs, energy insights, and health safety guidance.

states.empty: Log your weight for a few days to see trend charts.

screens.layout: Interactive weight chart, weekly AI review summary card, energy readiness breakdown, and medical disclaimer footer.

screens.name: Settings & Privacy
screens.purpose: Privacy controls, HealthKit/Health Connect permissions, language toggle (English/Telugu), and account security.
screens.layout: Grouped list items with native toggles for Health Connect, language selector, privacy compliance notices, and sign out.

hero_banner.alt: Healthy Indian wholesome food bowl with nutritious millets and vegetables

instructions_to_main_agent: Build NutriMitra as a premium, calm, Indian-focused wellness companion using Hand-Drawn / Journal styling with Editorial structure.
Support full bilingual English and Telugu localization across all screens and prompts.
Implement the 10 core screens: Auth, Onboarding Profile, 7-Day Plan, Daily Dashboard, What Should I Eat Now, Meal/Photo Tracking, AI Coach, Workouts, Progress, and Settings/Privacy.
Include Apple Health / Health Connect permission architecture and manual activity entry with clear estimate labels.
Ensure sticky bottom CTAs with safe-area padding and frosted glass headers over scrolling content.
Enforce WCAG AA contrast, font weight <= 500, no banned purple/indigo/navy colors, and zero emoji in system UI.
